title: Ontario Grade 9 & 10 Science Tutoring | Auxesis Education
description: One-to-one online Ontario Grade 9 and 10 science tutoring for SNC1W, SNC2D and SNC2P, with curriculum-aligned skills and MYP assessment support.
heading: Ontario Junior Secondary Science Tutoring
strapline: Building Scientific Understanding, Confidence and Independence
intro: Develop strong foundations in science through personalized, one-to-one online tutoring aligned with the Ontario curriculum.

Whether a student is beginning Grade 9 Science or preparing for more specialized courses in Grades 11 and 12, I help make scientific concepts accessible through clear explanations, visual models, interactive simulations and guided problem-solving.

Lessons are tailored to the student's current course, individual learning needs and academic goals. The emphasis is on understanding scientific ideas, making connections and developing the confidence to apply knowledge independently.

courses.title: Grade 9 Science
courses.intro: This course introduces students to fundamental concepts in Biology, Chemistry, Physics, and Earth and Space Science.

topics.title: Biology: Sustainable Ecosystems and Climate Change
topics.text: Explore the relationships between organisms and their environments, including biodiversity, food webs, energy flow, cycles of matter, ecosystem stability and the effects of human activity. Students develop an understanding of how ecosystems function and how scientific evidence can be used to investigate environmental change.

topics.title: Chemistry: The Nature of Matter
topics.text: Investigate the structure and properties of matter, including atoms, elements, compounds, the periodic table, physical and chemical properties, and changes in matter. Students learn to recognize patterns, interpret chemical representations and explain the behaviour of substances using scientific models.

topics.title: Physics: Electricity
topics.text: Explore static and current electricity, electrical circuits, current, voltage, resistance, electrical energy and energy efficiency. Students develop confidence in interpreting circuit diagrams, understanding electrical relationships and applying scientific principles to practical situations.

topics.title: Earth and Space Science: Space Exploration
topics.text: Investigate the solar system, the universe, astronomical phenomena and technologies used in space exploration. Students examine how scientific discoveries contribute to our understanding of space and how developments in space technology influence life on Earth.

courses.title: Grade 10 Science
courses.intro: This course builds on the foundations established in Grade 9, allowing students to develop a deeper understanding of scientific concepts and strengthen their investigation and problem-solving skills. Support is adapted to the expectations, learning approaches and assessment requirements of the student's specific course.

topics.title: Biology: Tissues, Organs and Systems
topics.text: Understand cell specialization, tissues, organs and organ systems, including how structures and functions are connected within living organisms. Students learn to interpret biological diagrams, explain interactions between body systems and connect scientific understanding to health and technology.

topics.title: Chemistry: Chemical Reactions
topics.text: Develop an understanding of chemical formulas, compounds, chemical reactions and the conservation of matter. Students receive support with writing and balancing equations, identifying reaction types and understanding chemical changes through particle models and practical examples.

topics.title: Physics: Light and Optics
topics.text: Investigate the properties and behaviour of light, including reflection, refraction, mirrors, lenses and optical technologies. Students learn to interpret ray diagrams, explain image formation and apply the principles of optics to familiar situations.

topics.title: Earth and Space Science: Climate Change
topics.text: Examine Earth's climate systems, factors that influence climate, scientific evidence of climate change and the effects of environmental changes on natural and human systems. Students develop skills in interpreting evidence, evaluating information and making connections between scientific processes and real-world issues.

skillsIntro: Science learning involves much more than remembering facts and definitions. Throughout Grades 9 and 10, I help students develop the skills needed to investigate scientific questions, interpret evidence and communicate their understanding. In keeping with Ontario's achievement framework, lessons strengthen four interconnected areas:

skills.title: Knowledge and Understanding
skills.text: Develop accurate scientific knowledge and a clear understanding of scientific concepts, principles and processes.

skills.title: Thinking and Investigation
skills.text: Investigate scientific questions, analyse and interpret data, and use scientific evidence to draw well-supported conclusions.

skills.title: Communication
skills.text: Explain scientific ideas clearly using appropriate terminology, diagrams, graphs, equations and organized written responses.

skills.title: Application
skills.text: Apply scientific understanding to unfamiliar situations, solve problems and make connections between concepts and the world around us.

assessment: Students receive targeted support with the knowledge, understanding and scientific skills required for their classroom assessments. Lessons can address tests, scientific investigations, experimental data, assignments, written explanations and examinations where applicable.
Deconstruct questions to identify what is being asked, apply relevant scientific knowledge and reasoning, and construct clear, evidence-based responses.
Students develop an understanding of Ontario's achievement criteria and how to demonstrate their knowledge and scientific skills effectively. Their assessed work remains their own.
conclusion: Grades 9 and 10 provide important foundations for future learning in Biology, Chemistry and other scientific disciplines.
By developing strong conceptual understanding and independent problem-solving skills, students become better prepared for the increasing demands of senior secondary science.
cta: Every student begins with a free Meet & Greet to discuss their current course, learning needs and goals. Lessons are then designed around the individual student, supporting both immediate classroom learning and longer-term scientific understanding.
related: Ontario Senior Secondary Biology and Chemistry

mypSupport.title: MYP Science Support
mypSupport.intro: Students following the IB Middle Years Programme receive support with the scientific content taught at their school, just as they would with any other science curriculum. Where relevant, lessons also address the MYP assessment criteria in relation to a student's specific assessment task. This helps students understand the expectations, develop appropriate scientific skills and communicate their understanding effectively while completing their own work independently.

title: Ontario Grade 11 & 12 Biology and Chemistry Tutoring | Auxesis
description: Personalized online Ontario Grade 11 and 12 Biology and Chemistry tutoring. Support for university and college preparation courses and assessment skills.
heading: Ontario Senior Secondary Biology and Chemistry Tutoring
strapline: Deepening Scientific Understanding and Developing Analytical Confidence
intro: Senior secondary science introduces students to increasingly complex biological and chemical systems, requiring deeper conceptual understanding, stronger analytical skills and greater independence.
I provide personalized, one-to-one online tutoring aligned with the Ontario curriculum, supporting students through university and college preparation pathways.

Lessons are tailored to the student's course expectations, learning needs and goals. Using interactive models, visual simulations, guided investigations, structured explanations and worked examples, I help students connect scientific ideas and understand underlying principles rather than relying on memorization or procedures alone.

In Biology, students learn to interpret biological diagrams and experimental evidence, analyse data, explain processes and connect structures with functions. In Chemistry, they learn to move between chemical representations, explain reactions at the particle level and solve multi-step calculations through logical reasoning. Across both subjects, lessons develop conceptual understanding, practical scientific skills, clear explanations and the confidence to apply knowledge independently in unfamiliar and real-world contexts.

courses.title: Grade 11 Biology
courses.intro: This course introduces students to the diversity and complexity of living organisms, exploring how biological systems function, change and interact.

topics.title: Diversity of Living Things
topics.text: Classification, biodiversity and evolutionary relationships.

topics.title: Evolution
topics.text: Natural selection, adaptation, speciation and evidence supporting evolutionary change.

topics.title: Genetic Processes
topics.text: Cell division, inheritance, chromosomes and genetic variation.

topics.title: Animals: Structure and Function
topics.text: The organization and function of animal tissues, organs and systems.

topics.title: Plants: Anatomy, Growth and Function
topics.text: Plant structures, physiological processes and their relationships to environmental conditions.

courses.title: Grade 11 Biology
courses.intro: This course focuses on understanding biological systems and their applications in everyday life, health, technology and the environment.

topics.title: Areas of study
topics.text: Cellular biology, microbiology, genetics, mammalian anatomy and plants in the natural environment.

courses.title: Grade 12 Biology
courses.intro: This course examines biological processes at the molecular, cellular and systems levels.

topics.title: Biochemistry
topics.text: Biological molecules, enzymes and biochemical interactions.

topics.title: Metabolic Processes
topics.text: Cellular respiration, photosynthesis and energy transformations.

topics.title: Molecular Genetics
topics.text: DNA, gene expression, protein synthesis and biotechnology.

topics.title: Homeostasis
topics.text: Regulation and coordination of physiological processes.

topics.title: Population Dynamics
topics.text: Population growth, interactions and ecological relationships.

courses.title: Grade 11 Chemistry
courses.intro: This course establishes the foundation for understanding chemical behaviour, quantitative relationships and the interactions between substances.

topics.title: Structure and Bonding
topics.text: Atomic structure, periodic trends and chemical bonding.

topics.title: Chemical Reactions
topics.text: Chemical reactions and balancing equations.

topics.title: Quantitative Chemistry
topics.text: The mole concept, stoichiometry and quantitative chemical calculations.

topics.title: Solutions
topics.text: Solutions, concentration and solubility.

topics.title: Gases and Atmosphere
topics.text: Gases and atmospheric chemistry.

courses.title: Grade 12 Chemistry
courses.intro: This course develops a more advanced understanding of chemical structures, reactions and systems.

topics.title: Organic Chemistry
topics.text: Functional groups, nomenclature, structures and reactions.

topics.title: Structure and Properties of Matter
topics.text: Bonding, molecular structure and intermolecular forces.

topics.title: Energy Changes and Rates of Reaction
topics.text: Thermochemistry, kinetics and factors affecting reaction rates.

topics.title: Chemical Systems and Equilibrium
topics.text: Equilibrium principles, acids and bases, and quantitative relationships.

topics.title: Electrochemistry
topics.text: Oxidation and reduction, electrochemical cells and electrolysis.

courses.title: Grade 12 Chemistry
courses.intro: This course develops practical chemical knowledge and problem-solving skills with applications in industry, technology, health and the environment.

topics.title: Areas of study
topics.text: Matter and qualitative analysis, organic chemistry, electrochemistry, chemical calculations and chemistry in the environment.

skillsIntro: Senior Biology and Chemistry require students to work with increasingly complex information, connect concepts and communicate scientific reasoning precisely. Aligned with Ontario's achievement framework, tutoring supports four interconnected areas:

skills.title: Knowledge and Understanding
skills.text: Establish a clear understanding of scientific principles and the relationships between processes, structures and systems.

skills.title: Thinking and Investigation
skills.text: Investigate scientific questions, analyse and interpret data, and use scientific evidence to draw well-supported conclusions. Evaluate evidence, identify relationships, recognize limitations and justify explanations.

skills.title: Communication
skills.text: Construct clear, logically organized scientific responses using appropriate terminology, calculations, diagrams, graphs, equations and evidence.

skills.title: Application
skills.text: Apply scientific knowledge to unfamiliar problems, make connections between concepts and interpret scientific situations in real-world contexts.

assessment: Students receive targeted support with classroom assessments throughout their course. This may include scientific investigations, laboratory analysis, assignments, tests, written responses and end-of-course examinations.
Deconstruct questions to identify what is being asked, apply relevant scientific knowledge and reasoning, and construct clear, evidence-based responses.

Students develop the ability to interpret assessment instructions, select relevant scientific evidence and communicate their reasoning with precision. The aim is lasting scientific understanding and independent academic skills, not simply preparation for individual assessments. Their assessed work remains their own.
conclusion: Biology and Chemistry provide foundations for a wide range of postsecondary programmes, including health sciences, life sciences, environmental studies, laboratory sciences and related fields.

Whether a student plans to attend university or college, tutoring is tailored to the requirements of their current course and intended academic pathway. Students are supported in developing the scientific knowledge, analytical confidence and independent learning skills needed for their next stage of education.
